title: Three laboratories
body: Foundations, the Model Playground, and the Text Lab. You are in Foundations now, where every number is worked out by hand.

title: The mission card
body: Each mission teaches one idea. Follow the goal, use the hint if you are stuck, and check your solution.

title: The worked example
body: Hover any connection, matrix cell, or node; its partners light up so you can trace every multiplication.

title: A live neural network
body: Neurons glow as they activate, and connections thicken with their weight. New controls appear here as the missions introduce them.

title: The decision boundary
body: The decision boundary shows what the model predicts across the whole plane as it learns.

title: XP and the quest map
body: Completing missions earns XP and unlocks the next card on your map. Good luck!
